_comment: Bedrock Dedicated Server with playit.gg tunnel (no port forwarding) and MCXboxBroadcast (join from Xbox friends list).
name: Bedrock + Tunnel + Broadcast
author: keinosuke575@gmail.com
description: Minecraft Bedrock Edition server that works without port forwarding (playit.gg UDP tunnel) and shows up in the Xbox friends list (MCXboxBroadcast).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl install script: downloads Bedrock Dedicated Server.
apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl jq unzip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server || exit 1

UA="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36"
if [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" ]; then
  URL=$(curl -sSL -H "Accept-Language: en" -H "User-Agent: $UA" \
    https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links \
    | jq -r '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType == "serverBedrockLinux") | .downloadUrl')
else
  URL="https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip"
fi

echo "Downloading $URL"
curl -fsSL -H "Accept-Language: en" -H "User-Agent: $UA" -o bedrock-server.zip "$URL" || exit 1

# Keep user data on reinstall.
unzip -o bedrock-server.zip -x server.properties allowlist.json permissions.json
[ -f server.properties ] || unzip -o bedrock-server.zip server.properties
rm bedrock-server.zip
chmod +x bedrock_server
mkdir -p worlds

echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list and friends list.

variables.name: Use playit tunnel
variables.description: 1 = start the playit.gg agent so no port forwarding is needed.

variables.name: playit secret
variables.description: Optional agent secret. Leave empty to claim via the URL printed in the console.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: Tunnel host from the playit dashboard (e.g. xxx.gl.joinmc.link). Advertised to friends.

variables.name: Public port
variables.description: Tunnel public UDP port from the playit dashboard.

variables.name: Use friends-list broadcast
variables.description: 1 = run MCXboxBroadcast so friends can join from the friends list.

variables.name: Broadcast game version
variables.description: Version string shown in the session. Update when BDS updates.

variables.name: Broadcast protocol
variables.description: Protocol number matching the BDS version.
